files.name: ShoreStepOut.java

help: In water after shore failed: dig a dry pocket into the wall just above the waterline and climb into it
lesson: Shore keeps timing out in enclosed underground water where swimming to remembered land and pillaring both lost; making dry ground right beside the bot above the waterline (where water can't flow in) needs no route at all.
summary: shore_step_out: after shore TIMEOUT/STUCK in (underground) water, digs a dry 2-high pocket into the adjacent wall one block above the waterline and climbs into it, instead of routing elsewhere
